name: Design Lagann blind reference-relative benchmark
mission: Measure whether Design Lagann produces work that feels more art-directed, memorable, and human-designed than the same coding agent with no design layer, Impeccable alone, or Design DNA alone.

requiredEvidence: desktop, tablet, and mobile screenshots with SHA-256
input, output, and total token counts

blindEvaluation.mappingCommitment: SHA-256 of a post-rating-revealed salt plus the canonical artifact-to-variant mapping
blindEvaluation.pairing: all unordered variant pairs within each brief and repetition
requiredHumanMeasures: five-minute unaided recall for both artifacts

claimGate.claimLanguage: Passing authorizes a bounded claim for this benchmark corpus only; it never proves universal design superiority.

claimRule: Incomplete, unblinded, internally inconsistent, or unrated evidence cannot produce an analysis or quality claim. A complete corpus may be analyzed; a quality claim is allowed only if every claim gate also passes.
